snippet.title: Rugby World Cup 2011 | PS3 Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
This was my first match of the Rugby World Cup 2011 demo on PS3:
So far it seems like a good game, graphics and overall gameplay seem ok.
Remember to leave a comment, tell me what your first impressions are of this game,
Also it would be great if you can subscribe because there will be a lot more gameplay videos and commentaries that i will be uploading soon.
